summary: iter95cw frontend verification — per-type koszt_prognozowany formula + cennik auto-copy of koszt_wykonania for labor. All 3 formulas correct in UI; pick-from-cennik flow updates labor kosztPrognozowany to qty × koszt_wykonania.
testing_performed: Seeded via API: wycena 'TEST_iter95cw_PROGNOZ' with 1 stage, 1 position, 3 lines (labor qty=10/cena=100/narzut=20/kw=null, materials qty=10/cena=5/narzut=20, equipment qty=5/cena=100/narzut=0) + cennik labor item 'TEST_LABOR_kw42' with koszt_wykonania=42.
Opened wycena in /admin → Wyceny tab → editor. Read 'koszt prognozowany' column (data-testid='sub-row-<id>' td index 13).
Initial: LAB=1000,00 (fallback qty*cena because kw=null) ✓ ; MAT=60,00 (10*5*1.2) ✓ ; EQ=500,00 (5*100, no markup) ✓
Clicked data-testid='sub-book-<labor_line_id>' (BookOpen icon), searched 'TEST_LABOR_kw42' in cennik picker, selected item. Toast 'Wybrano: TEST_LABOR_kw42' appeared.
After pick: LAB kosztPrognozowany = 420,00 (10 × 42) ✓ — confirms cennik koszt_wykonania auto-copied to subrow and per-type labor formula uses kw when set.

Regression: Cennik labor created with koszt_wykonania=42 persisted (iter95cv column still works). Editor renders normally — no console errors related to the feature (only Google Maps API key warning unrelated).
Cleanup: deleted test wycena and test cennik item via API.
critical_code_review_comments: No issues with iter95cw implementation. Formula and auto-copy work end-to-end (frontend + backend persistence + recomputation on render).

Note: koszt_wykonania has no manual input field on the subrow yet — value can only be set via cennik pick. If a user wants to manually adjust it later they must re-pick from cennik or edit via API. Consider exposing an input (informational, not blocking).
